The remaining part of the film was supposedly to be shot during the third and last schedule to be held in Mumbai, which was to start in late February.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-53) However, sourced clarified that the subsequent schedule, too, would be held in Chennai only, with filming being carried on at the Padmanabha Theatre in North Chennai. In late March, the crew eventually moved to Mumbai, where the filming was held for nearly two weeks, mostly at the Dharavi slum. The climax portion was planned to be filmed at Madurai, which was considered as "apt" for the "action-oriented" sequence, but was eventually filmed in Chennai as well, while the remaining scenes were to be canned in Hyderabad.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-54) During the first week of June, Ajith had reportedly completed his portion, with his last day shoot being held in Hyderabad,_[citation needed_] while sources confirmed that filming was still being carried on later that month in Hyderabad.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-55) Shooting was further extended, with the crew leaving for Bangkok again in late June for a ten-day schedule to shoot the pending scenes, including a lengthy fight sequence and a song, involving Premji and Lakshmi Rai. Despite earlier announcement that Ajith had finished his portions, a "special scene" featuring Ajith in a different look was filmed on one day during the first week of July. Principal photography ended by June 2011.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-56)

_Mankatha_'spost-production works commenced by mid-June 2011,[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-57) and were carried on for over one month. Earlier, an animation sequence lasting about 4 minutes was being created by specialised technicians, while CGI special effects were included in a song and action scenes, which was cited as the reason for the delay. By early August, all actors but Ajith had finished dubbing for their characters, including Trisha, who on Venkat Prabhu's insistence, dubbed for herself in the film.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-58) Thus, Mankatha became only the third Tamil film to feature her original voice. Rekhs, who had previously subtitled films including _Enthiran_ and _Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa_, subtitled _Mankatha_ during the first week of August, while Yuvan Shankar Raja worked on the re-recording,[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-59) being assisted by Premji.

The film score and soundtrack of _Mankatha_ were composed by Yuvan Shankar Raja,[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-sify3-46) becoming his fourth collaboration with Venkat Prabhu and Ajith as well._[citation needed_] The soundtrack, consists of eight tracks, including one Theme music track and one club mix, with lyrics penned by Vaali, and Gangai Amaran and renowned poet Subramanya Bharathi's grandson, Niranjan Bharathi.[[60]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-60) As earlier done in _Saroja_ and _Goa_, a promotional track too was planned, which however did not materialise in last minute. Prior to the official soundtrack launch, a single track, "Vilaiyaadu Mankatha", was released in mid-May 2011. The music rights were secured by Sony Music who had reportedly offered ₹ 10 million.[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-61) The soundtrack album, following several postponements,[[62]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-62) was released on 10 August 2011 at Radio Mirchi's Chennai station,[[63]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-63) while two days later the team arranged a press meet, showcasing two songs and the trailer of the film.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-autogenerated2-13) The album was reported to have achieved record breaking sales.[[64]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-64)

Even before beginning the principal photography, a short teaser trailer was shot on the day of the launch itself, since it coincided with Aadi Perukku and was considered an auspicious day.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-indiatimes1-23) The first teaser was screened along with the film _Naan Mahaan Alla_, another Cloud Nine Movies distribution that released on 20 August 2010.[[65]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-65) During Diwali 2010, the first look posters of _Mankatha_ were published in newspapers.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-sify4-47) A teaser featuring the song "Vilaiyaadu Mankatha" was released on Ajith's birthday, on 1 May 2011 on YouTube,[[66]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-66) after plans of releasing the film or the soundtrack on that day had failed. As the teaser garnered high response, the song was released as a single track on 20 May 2011, creating positive media response.[[67]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-67)_Mankatha_merchandise were launched for sale after the 50th day. Items included exclusive sun glasses, t-shirts, hand cuffs, and pendants, etc. – all on a limited edition basis._[citation needed_]

_Mankatha_ was given a U/A certificate by the Censor Board after heavy censorship of profane words.[[68]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-68) The British Board of Film Classification issued a 15 certificate with an advice that it "contains strong threat and violence".[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-Bbfc.co.uk-1) Later, the distributor reduced violence in three reels and secured a 12A classification for theatrical release.[[69]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-69) During the late production stage, reports indicated that _Mankatha_ faced "political pressure" following the change in government after the 2011 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly election,[[70]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-70) with sources claiming that the film did not find any buyers in Tamil Nadu, since it was produced by the grandson of DMK president M. Karunanidhi.[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-71)[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-72) Cloud Nine Movies began negotiations with other production houses to sell the domestical theatrical rights, however talks with UTV Motion Pictures and Gemini Film Circuit resulted in failure.[[73]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-73) On 22 August 2011, Gnanavelraja confirmed that his production house Studio Green, had purchased the Indian domestic theatrical and the television rights of the film at an undisclosed record amount.[[74]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mankatha#cite_note-74)

Every September, the streets of Little Italy in New York City come alive with the unique and vibrant San Gennaro Feast. This time-honored celebration, a fixture of the neighborhood for nearly a century, is a must-visit for anyone interested in Italian-American culture and culinary traditions. The feast, known for its unique blend of Italian-American culture and the patron saint of Naples, San Gennaro, will take place from September 12th to September 22nd, 2024, marking another chapter in its storied tradition.

## A Brief History of the San Gennaro Feast
The San Gennaro Feast, with its roots in the early 20th century, is a testament to the enduring spirit of the Italian-American community. The first feast, held in September 1926, was a small, religious event designed to celebrate the saint’s feast day on September 19th. Over the years, it grew into a large, vibrant street festival, reflecting the growing Italian-American community in New York. This rich history and tradition make the San Gennaro Feast a unique and cherished event, connecting us to the generations of Italian-Americans who have celebrated it before us.
Today, the San Gennaro Feast is one of the city’s largest and most beloved street festivals, drawing over a million visitors annually. It’s a time when the tight-knit community of Little Italy opens its arms to people from all walks of life, inviting them to share in the joy, culture, and history that the feast embodies.

## The Festival Experience
Stretching along Mulberry Street, the heart of Little Italy, the San Gennaro Feast is a sensory explosion. The streets are lined with vendors selling traditional Italian foods such as zeppole, cannoli, sausages, and pasta dishes, all prepared using time-honored recipes passed down through generations. The aroma of these culinary delights fills the air, tempting festival-goers to indulge in the rich flavors of Italian cuisine.
**One of the standout contributors to this experience is Ferrara Bakery & Cafe, a cherished institution that has been part of the Little Italy community for over 132 years. Known for its authentic Italian pastries, Ferrara has been a cornerstone of the San Gennaro Feast, offering festival-goers a taste of tradition through its famous cannoli, biscotti, rainbow cookies and many other desserts.** Every year, Ferrara becomes a must-visit destination at the festival, where visitors can enjoy the bakery’s classic offerings that have been perfected over more than a century. The bakery’s deep roots in the community make it not just a participant but a symbol of the enduring Italian-American heritage celebrated at the feast.

## The Significance of the Feast
The San Gennaro Feast is more than just a celebration of Italian-American culture; it is a living testament to the enduring spirit of New York’s immigrant communities. For the residents of Little Italy, the festival is an opportunity to honor their heritage, connect with their roots, and pass on their traditions to future generations. It’s a time when the past and present come together, creating a vibrant tapestry of cultural identity.
Moreover, the feast symbolizes the broader cultural mosaic that defines New York City. It serves as a reminder of the rich diversity that makes the city so unique, bringing together people of different backgrounds to celebrate a shared sense of community. Whether you’re Italian-American or simply a lover of good food and lively festivities, the San Gennaro Feast offers something for everyone.

## Conclusion
As the San Gennaro Feast returns to Little Italy from September 12th to September 22nd, 2024, it promises to be a celebration like no other. This beloved tradition continues to thrive, offering a taste of Italy in the heart of New York City. Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a seasoned festival-goer, be sure to stop by Ferrara Bakery & Cafe to experience a piece of Italian-American history through its delicious pastries and be sure to visit them online. The feast is more than just an event—it’s a true celebration of tradition, culture, and community.

### FAQs
#### **Where is Universal Music Group located?**
UMG has offices in approximately 60 countries. Universal Music Group N.V.’s corporate headquarters are located at ‘s-Gravelandseweg 80, 1217 EW in Hilversum, Netherlands and its operational headquarters are located at 2220 Colorado Avenue in Santa Monica, California.

### FAQs
#### **How do I obtain information on internships and employment at your organization?**
For information on working for Universal Music please visit our Careers page.

### FAQs
#### **How can I find out more about artists on the Universal Music Group roster?**
For the latest artist information, please visit our individual labelwebsiteswhich will also have the most current social media information for your favorite artists and bands. For additional updates, you can also follow the Universal Music GroupFacebook,Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and Xaccounts.

### FAQs
#### **How do I submit a demo to Universal Music Group?**
Demo submissions should be directed to UMG’s record labels, but kindly note that they are unable to accept unsolicited material. Typically, demos are recommended to one of our labels’ A&R departments by a manager, agent, producer, radio DJ or other industry professional.
Please be aware: UMG employees will NEVER request anything of value in exchange for submitting music or securing a contract with our labels, or for your participation in any other activities in which UMG is engaged. Such action is directly contrary to UMG’s Code of Conduct. If anyone claiming to be affiliated with UMG fraudulently demands money from you to submit a demo, or as a purported “contract fee” or to defray “travel costs,” please be aware that this is a scam.

### FAQs
#### **I am a company or brand looking to partner with a Universal Music Group label or artist. Where should I direct my inquiry?**
The Universal Music Group For Brands division provides innovative, tailor-made business solutions to companies and brands. Please visit the websitefor further information and contact details.

### FAQs
#### **I am interested in licensing music for a project. How do I go about doing this?**
Licensing requests should be directed to your local Universal Music Group office. To find details of the office in your country pleaseclick here. If you are in the United States and would like to license the master recording of a Universal Music Group artist please contact the Universal Music Enterprises Film & TV Department by visiting the Contact Us page on the UMG Sync website, or call the information hotline 310-865-0770.
If you would like to obtain rights to use a song or lyrics from a song that is published by Universal Music Publishing Group, please send your request via email to [umpg.licensing@umusic.com](mailto:umpg.licensing@umusic.com). If you are unsure whether UMPG is the proper contact for your request, information on a song’s publishing company is usually found on the album’s packaging. You may also find publishing information on ascap.com, bmi.com,sesac.com orthemic.com

### FAQs
#### **I believe that I may be owed royalties from Universal Music Group, who may I contact for assistance?**
If you believe you are owed either artist or mechanical royalties from a Universal Music Group Label, or have not received a statement, we may not have your correct address on file. Please visit theUMG Royalty Statement Portalto sign up to view your royalty statements online and find out how to update your address. If you have an issue related to Artist or Mechanical Royalties that requires you to speak to someone, you may leave a message with the Royalty Help Line (1-888-583-7176) or contact us by email at[RoyaltyHelp@umusic.com](mailto:RoyaltyHelp@umusic.com). Please include your full name, phone number and a brief description of the issue in your message. Someone on our service team will either call or email you back within 5 business days.
If your songs are published through Universal Music Publishing Group (UMPG), or you otherwise believe you are owed Royalties from UMPG, you may visitUMPG Windowto view your royalties. If you have questions you can leave a message with the UMPG Royalty Customer Service Line (1-888-474-4979) or contact UMPG by email at[umpg.royalty@umusic.com](mailto:umpg.royalty@umusic.com). Please include your full name and phone number in your message. For additional information you may also visit theFor UMG Artistssection on this website.

### FAQs
#### **I found your music being distributed or sold illegally on another web site or service. How can I report this?**
If you see an example of UMG music being illegally distributed please feel free to contact us at [ContentProtection@umusic.com](mailto:ContentProtection@umusic.com).

### FAQs
#### **I’m a member of the news media, how can I contact someone in your communications department?**
Please contact us via email at[communications@umusic.com](mailto:communications@umusic.com)and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate contact.

### FAQs
#### **I’m an investor or potential investor in UMG, how can I contact someone in your investor relations department?**
Please contact our investor relations team via email at[investorrelations@umusic.com](mailto:investorrelations@umusic.com).

**Universal Music Group N.V.**[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-:3-5) (often abbreviated as **UMG** and referred to as **Universal Music Group** or **Universal Music**) is a Dutch-American music corporation under Dutch law. While UMG's corporate headquarters are located in Hilversum, Netherlands, its operational headquarters are located in Santa Monica, California.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-6)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-7) As the biggest music company in the world,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-8) it is one of the "Big Three" record labels, along with Sony Music Entertainment and Warner Music Group. Tencent acquired ten percent of Universal Music Group in March 2020 for €3 billion[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-9)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-10)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-11) and acquired an additional ten percent stake in January 2021.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-12)Pershing Square Holdings later acquired ten percent of UMG before its IPO on the Euronext Amsterdam stock exchange. The French Bolloré family still owns 28 percent of UMG (18 percent directly, and ten percent through Vivendi, formerly Vivendi Universal, the Bolloré family's investment company). The company went public on September 21, 2021, at a valuation of €46 billion.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-:2-13)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-14)
As of April 2024, UMG's catalogue includes over three million recordings and four million compositions.

## History
### Early history
The company's origins go back to the formation of the American branch of Decca Records in September 1934, and its name and company logo originate from Carl Laemmle's Universal Pictures. Although the movie studio and the music business share a common history, today the former is part of Comcast and the latter an independent commercial entity.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-15)[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-16) During World War II, many record companies donated their metal masters to recycling for the war effort. However, Universal was an exception and donated more than 200,000 of their historic master recordings to the Library of Congress.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-17) The Decca Record Co. Ltd. of England spun American Decca off in 1939.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-18)[MCA Inc.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MCA_Inc. "MCA Inc.") merged with American Decca in 1962.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-19)

## History
### Early history
In November 1990, Japanese multinational conglomerate Matsushita Electric agreed to acquire MCA for $6.59 billion.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-20)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-21) In 1995, [Seagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seagram_Company_Ltd. "Seagram Company Ltd.") acquired 80 percent of MCA from Matsushita.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-22)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-23) On December 9, 1996, the company was renamed [Universal Studios, Inc.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Studios,_Inc. "Universal Studios, Inc."),[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-24) and its music division was renamed Universal Music Group; MCA Records continued as a label within the Universal Music Group. In May 1998, Seagram purchased PolyGram[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-25) and merged it with Universal Music Group in early 1999.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-26) Seagram's entertainment assets were then sold to French media conglomerate Vivendi in 2000, along with UMG.

## History
### 2004: Consolidating into a Vivendi subsidiary
In May 2004, Universal Music Group was cast under separate management from Universal Studios, when Vivendi sold 80% of Universal to General Electric, who subsequently merged it with NBC to form NBCUniversal. This came two months after the separation of Warner Music Group from Time Warner. In February 2006, Vivendi purchased the remaining 20 percent of UMG from Matsushita Electric.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-27) On September 6, 2006, Vivendi announced its €1.63 billion ($2.4 billion) purchase of BMG Music Publishing; after receiving European Union regulatory approval, the acquisition was completed on June 25, 2007.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-28)[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-29)

**Universal Music Group N.V.**[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-:3-5) (often abbreviated as **UMG** and referred to as **Universal Music Group** or **Universal Music**) is a Dutch-American music corporation under Dutch law. While UMG's corporate headquarters are located in Hilversum, Netherlands, its operational headquarters are located in Santa Monica, California.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-6)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-7) As the biggest music company in the world,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-8) it is one of the "Big Three" record labels, along with Sony Music Entertainment and Warner Music Group. Tencent acquired ten percent of Universal Music Group in March 2020 for €3 billion[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-9)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-10)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-11) and acquired an additional ten percent stake in January 2021.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-12)Pershing Square Holdings later acquired ten percent of UMG before its IPO on the Euronext Amsterdam stock exchange. The French Bolloré family still owns 28 percent of UMG (18 percent directly, and ten percent through Vivendi, formerly Vivendi Universal, the Bolloré family's investment company). The company went public on September 21, 2021, at a valuation of €46 billion.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-:2-13)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-14)
As of April 2024, UMG's catalogue includes over three million recordings and four million compositions.

## History
### Early history
The company's origins go back to the formation of the American branch of Decca Records in September 1934, and its name and company logo originate from Carl Laemmle's Universal Pictures. Although the movie studio and the music business share a common history, today the former is part of Comcast and the latter an independent commercial entity.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-15)[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-16) During World War II, many record companies donated their metal masters to recycling for the war effort. However, Universal was an exception and donated more than 200,000 of their historic master recordings to the Library of Congress.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-17) The Decca Record Co. Ltd. of England spun American Decca off in 1939.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-18)[MCA Inc.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MCA_Inc. "MCA Inc.") merged with American Decca in 1962.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-19)

## History
### Early history
In November 1990, Japanese multinational conglomerate Matsushita Electric agreed to acquire MCA for $6.59 billion.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-20)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-21) In 1995, [Seagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seagram_Company_Ltd. "Seagram Company Ltd.") acquired 80 percent of MCA from Matsushita.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-22)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-23) On December 9, 1996, the company was renamed [Universal Studios, Inc.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Studios,_Inc. "Universal Studios, Inc."),[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-24) and its music division was renamed Universal Music Group; MCA Records continued as a label within the Universal Music Group. In May 1998, Seagram purchased PolyGram[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-25) and merged it with Universal Music Group in early 1999.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-26) Seagram's entertainment assets were then sold to French media conglomerate Vivendi in 2000, along with UMG.

## History
### 2004: Consolidating into a Vivendi subsidiary
In May 2004, Universal Music Group was cast under separate management from Universal Studios, when Vivendi sold 80% of Universal to General Electric, who subsequently merged it with NBC to form NBCUniversal. This came two months after the separation of Warner Music Group from Time Warner. In February 2006, Vivendi purchased the remaining 20 percent of UMG from Matsushita Electric.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-27) On September 6, 2006, Vivendi announced its €1.63 billion ($2.4 billion) purchase of BMG Music Publishing; after receiving European Union regulatory approval, the acquisition was completed on June 25, 2007.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-28)[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group#cite_note-29)

Hilversum events calendar
Films, choirs, Sinterklaas, Top 2000 tributes and a spring fair: Hilversum has plenty on, all within reach of the centre.
Published 30 October 2026 6 min read By Alphabet Apartments
Hilversum is best known as the home of Dutch television, but its event calendar deserves just as much attention. From November 2026 to May 2027 the city hosts a film festival, a choir festival with a Christmas market, a Sinterklaas parade, four days of Top 2000 tribute concerts and a ten-day spring fair. Here is a verified overview, with an apartment on the Kerkstraat right in the centre.
Book now

## November: film, Sinterklaas and a choir festival
**Film Festival Hilversum** runs from **4 to 8 November 2026** at Filmtheater Hilversum on the Herenplein, with previews, classics and special guests.
Source: Live Hilversum, events calendar.
On **Sunday 15 November 2026** Sinterklaas arrives by boat in the Oude Haven. The parade leaves the Taludweg at around 14:15 and passes through the centre, including the **Kerkstraat**, before finishing on the Marktplein at around 16:00.
Source: Sintintocht Hilversum, route 2026.
On **Saturday 28 November 2026** the **Peace of Cake Choir Festival** returns as a Christmas edition at Studio 21 on the Media Park, with choirs on two stages and a Christmas market, from 10:00 to 22:00. Entry is €11, children under 12 go free, and Hilversum Media Park station is right next door.
Source: Peace of Cake Korenfestival.

## Exhibitions worth planning around
*   **Beeld & Geluid (Sound & Vision), Media Park:**_Beleef 75 jaar TV_ and the free exhibition _Heel Holland Zoekt_, both until 31 December 2026.  
*   **Fotomuseum Hilversum:** World Press Photo 2026 until 29 November 2026, and _BLOS – Where Colour, Textiles and Photography Meet_ until 7 February 2027.  
*   **DAC Dudok Architecture Centre:**_110 Years of Gispen in Buildings_ until 4 April 2027.
Sources: Museum.nl, Beeld & Geluid; Live Hilversum, events calendar.

## December: Live 2000 in the city centre
From **27 to 30 December 2026** the centre of Hilversum is dedicated to the Top 2000 during **Live 2000**, with free tribute concerts in a tent on the Marktplein and music at venues across town. Read our Live 2000 Hilversum guide for details.
Source: Live Hilversum, Live 2000.

## Spring 2027: the fair and King’s Day
The **Hilversum fair** (kermis) fills the Marktplein from **23 April to 2 May 2027**, open daily from 12:00. On **King’s Day, Tuesday 27 April 2027**, it opens early at 10:30.
Source: Live Hilversum, Kermis in Hilversum.

## Where to stay for Hilversum events
Alphabet Apartments has seven furnished studios and apartments on the **Kerkstraat** in the centre of Hilversum, a short walk from the Marktplein, Filmtheater Hilversum and the shopping streets. Beeld & Geluid and Studio 21 on the Media Park are easy to reach by train or bus. Visiting without a car? Our guide to a car-free short stay in Hilversum helps you plan the journey.
Book now

## Frequently asked questions
When is Film Festival Hilversum 2026?+  
Film Festival Hilversum takes place from 4 to 8 November 2026 at Filmtheater Hilversum.
When does Sinterklaas arrive in Hilversum in 2026?+  
On Sunday 15 November 2026. The parade ends on the Marktplein at around 16:00.
When is the Hilversum fair in 2027?+  
The fair is on the Marktplein from 23 April to 2 May 2027, including King’s Day on 27 April.
Where can I stay in central Hilversum?+  
Alphabet Apartments offers furnished studios and apartments on the Kerkstraat in the centre of Hilversum.
